verdict.rationale: Plausible's privacy posture (no personal data collected, no cookies, GDPR compliance) reduces the need for explicit deletion, and self-hosting plus data export give users control over their own data, but there is no documented retention-period setting or an explicit 'delete my data' control in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit data-retention configuration options, a documented data-deletion/right-to-erasure workflow, and independent confirmation that deletion requests are honored.
